items.prompt: Which of these is a repeating pattern?
items.explanation: A repeating pattern cycles through the same group over and over. Red, blue, red, blue keeps repeating the red-blue group, so it is a repeating pattern.

items.prompt: Which of these is an increasing pattern?
items.explanation: An increasing pattern grows by the same rule each step. 2, 4, 6, 8 grows by adding 2 each time.

items.prompt: What comes next: triangle, square, triangle, square, ___?
items.explanation: The pattern goes triangle, square, triangle, square, so after square comes triangle again.

items.prompt: Milo finds the pattern 3, 6, 9, 12. What does he need to tell to explain it?

options.text: how many numbers are in the pattern

items.explanation: To explain a pattern, name its rule. 3, 6, 9, 12 grows by adding 3 each time, so the rule is add 3.

items.prompt: Which pattern shows a rule that repeats the same group?
items.explanation: Red, blue, red, blue cycles the same group of colors over and over, so it is a repeating pattern. The others grow by a rule instead.
